theme.$description: The theme switch, in every app. After the Terminal Delight documentation site (github.com/parker-brown-family/terminal-delight, docsite/layout.html and assets/td-shell.js), extended from two states to three.
theme.control: one icon button at the right of the bar; each press moves system -> light -> dark -> system; the icon shows the current state (half-filled circle, sun, moon) and its label says the next
theme.stored: with the person's account (one field, theme_preference), so it follows them across devices and across every app in the suite
theme.mirror: a cookie hw-theme=<value> on the suite's shared parent domain (Path=/, SameSite=Lax, one year), written on every change and on sign-in from the account value; every app reads it on the server
theme.before_first_paint: the server renders data-theme-pref from the cookie and the class dark when the value is dark; for system, a five-line inline script in <head> adds dark from matchMedia(prefers-color-scheme: dark) before the body paints, and follows the device while it changes
theme.signed_out: a visitor without an account (a client on a booking page) gets this device's cookie if one exists, else system; the switch sits in the page footer and its choice stays on this device
theme.native: a native app reads the same account field after sign-in; before sign-in, system (Appearance API)

type.$description: Which face sets what. The display face sets only the frame roles, words the product ships; content, including a person's or record's name where a title goes, is the ui face; digits that line up are the figures face.
type.digits: No digit, price, time, date, count, table cell or form value is ever set in Federo. On the web the net below draws any that slip through in the next face of the stack; scripts/frame-digits.js finds them on a rendered screen.
type.unicode_range_use: put it on Federo's @font-face (next/font/local: declarations: [{ prop: "unicode-range", value: <this> }])
type.figures: IBM Plex Sans's figures line up by default (every digit 0.60 em), so amounts, totals and clocks are Plex as it stands (type-data). Never switch on old-style figures (onum) for data. The first candidate, DM Sans 4.004, had no tabular figures: at 16 px, 111.11 measured 28 px and 888.88 53 px with tabular-nums set.
type.emphasis: Federo has one weight and no italic. A frame string takes no emphasis inside it; one ranks above another by size and ink level. A word that needs emphasis inside a title is content, so it is Plex 600. font-synthesis: none on :root stops a browser faking bold or italic.
type.buttons: Federo, every button, the header's gel included; one weight, so a button ranks by its fill and size.
type.button_figures: A figure inside a button label is IBM Plex Sans at the same size: . A control whose label is only a number (a stepper, a page number, a count) is data, its plus and minus included. Keep the amount on a pay button.
type.licences: Each licence is read from its own OFL.txt (check R15). Both faces reserve their names, "Federo" and "Plex" (Plex's only in its OFL.txt). Ship each file as published, or a WOFF2 that only compresses it; a subset or other conversion is a modified version and may not use the name (OFL-FAQ 2.1, 2.6), so neither goes through next/font/google.
type.web: localFont({ src: "./fonts/Federo-Regular.woff2", variable: "--font-federo", weight: "400", display: "swap", declarations: [{ prop: "unicode-range", value: behaviour.type.unicode_range }] }); localFont({ src: "./fonts/IBMPlexSans-var.woff2", variable: "--font-ibm-plex-sans", weight: "100 700", display: "swap" })
type.native: Bundle @expo-google-fonts/federo and /ibm-plex-sans; native.type.<role>.fontFamily names the cut. Native has no unicode-range, so the frame text component throws in development on a digit.

native.$description: Plain numbers for a native theme (React Native, iPad, Android, Mac). Sizes are dp/pt, equal to CSS px. Fills are solid on native.

display.licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, Reserved Font Name "Federo": bundle the file as published, never a subset

ui.licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, Reserved Font Name "Plex": bundle the file as published, never a subset

native.button_label: the display face for the words; a run of figures inside the label in the text face at the same size; a label that is only a number is data (type-data)

header.glow: draw with react-native-svg: a RadialGradient centred on the top right corner, rx products.<name>.header_glow.reach-x of the width (base 38%), ry reach-y of the height (base 112%); stops glow-core at 0 and 0.14, glow-mid at 0.46, transparent at 1
header.glass: opaque on native: the ground, the glow, then white at 7% fading to 2%; expo-blur only for the frosted controls

motion.reducedMotion: durations 0; keep the press shadow and a 100 ms fade

dock.rule: width = min(760, window width - 2 x 24), so it shrinks in split view
